display.purpose: Module and lesson titles, with the overview allowed one larger chapter-plate expression.

headline.purpose: Major lesson sections and the largest instructional landmarks.

title.purpose: Subsections, laboratory titles, and compact teaching structures.

body.purpose: Sustained reading in the 68ch lesson measure.

label.purpose: Information types, tags, metadata, and chart axes; never smaller than 13px.

value.purpose: Tabular financial values, formula variables, lesson numbers, and control outputs.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: Overlays only: popovers, dialog, tooltips, drawer, toast. Dark: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4), 0 14px 36px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Orientation, reveal, and structural state transitions.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Control color changes and the 1px press response.

motion.name: duration-mid
motion.purpose: Lesson entry, reveal panels, progress, and the mobile rail.

motion.name: duration-plate
motion.purpose: Chapter plate wipe when a lesson opens.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive action for starting a lesson, checking work, or confirming a financial task.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:var(--s2); min-height:2.75rem; padding:0 var(--s4); border:1px solid var(--accent); border-radius:var(--r-control); background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-ink); font:500 var(--t-small)/1 var(--font-body); cursor:pointer; transition:background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out), border-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out), transform var(--dur-fast); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 88%, var(--ink)); border-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 88%, var(--ink)); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A low-emphasis shell control for glossary, theme, and utility actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:2.75rem; padding:0 var(--s4); border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:var(--r-control); background:transparent; color:var(--ink); font:500 var(--t-small)/1 var(--font-body); cursor:pointer; transition:background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out), transform var(--dur-fast); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:var(--surface-2); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Financial Field
components.description: A labeled numeric field with explicit guidance and tabular financial figures.
components.html: Enter the amount that reaches your bank account.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:var(--s1); min-width:0; font-family:var(--font-body); } .ds-field-label { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:var(--s2); align-items:baseline; color:var(--ink-2); font-size:var(--t-small); font-weight:500; } .ds-field-value { color:var(--ink); font:500 var(--t-small)/1.4 var(--font-mono); white-space:nowrap; } .ds-input { width:100%; min-height:2.75rem; padding:var(--s2) var(--s3); border:1px solid var(--control); border-radius:var(--r-control); background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink); font:inherit; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-input:hover { border-color:var(--ink-3); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color:var(--accent); outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:0; } .ds-field-hint { color:var(--ink-3); font-size:var(--t-micro); }

components.name: Lesson Rail Item
components.description: A numbered Part field row that preserves lesson position and makes the current destination unmistakable.
components.html: 0.4Compounding✓
components.css: .ds-rail-item { display:grid; grid-template-columns:2.25rem 1fr auto; align-items:baseline; gap:var(--s1); min-height:2.5rem; padding:var(--s2) var(--s3); border-radius:var(--r-control); color:var(--ink-2); font:400 var(--t-small)/1.35 var(--font-body); text-decoration:none; } .ds-rail-item:hover { background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--ink); } .ds-rail-item[aria-current="page"] { background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--ink); font-weight:600; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent-line); } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-rail-no { color:var(--ink-3); font:400 var(--t-micro)/1.35 var(--font-mono); } .ds-rail-item[aria-current="page"] .ds-rail-no { color:var(--accent); } .ds-rail-status { color:var(--pos); }

components.name: Current Data Tag
components.description: A dated, non-ambiguous marker for current facts that have been checked against an official source.
components.html: Current · verified
components.css: .ds-tag-current { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.35em; padding:.15em .6em; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:var(--r-pill); background:var(--pos-soft); color:var(--pos); font:600 var(--t-micro)/1.5 var(--font-body); white-space:nowrap; } .ds-tag-icon { width:.95em; height:.95em; flex:none; }

components.name: Worked Example Block
components.description: A flat, ruled teaching container that separates example data from interpretation without decorative elevation.
components.html:
Worked exampleHypothetical

Saving this month: ₹1,10,000 income − ₹82,000 spending = ₹28,000.

The ₹28,000 flow can become a larger stock only if it remains invested over time.
components.css: .ds-example { padding:var(--s4) var(--s5); border:1px solid var(--rule); border-radius:var(--r-block); background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink); font:400 var(--t-body)/var(--lh-body) var(--font-body); } .ds-example:hover { border-color:var(--rule-strong); } .ds-example-head { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:var(--s2); margin-bottom:var(--s3); } .ds-example-label { color:var(--ink-2); font-size:var(--t-micro); font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-example-tag { padding:.15em .6em; border:1px dashed currentColor; border-radius:var(--r-pill); color:var(--ink-2); font-size:var(--t-micro); font-weight:600; } .ds-example-copy { margin:0; } .ds-example-note { margin:var(--s3) 0 0; color:var(--ink-3); font-size:var(--t-small); }

components.name: Lab Bench
components.description: The signature Operate surface: a bounded control, live readouts, and an explanatory insight on a recessed working ground.
components.html:
Try it

Savings-rate explorer

Notice how a monthly flow changes the stock built after one year.

Monthly saving₹27,500
One-year flow₹3.30 lakh

At 25%, one quarter of take-home becomes a future stock instead of current spending.
components.css: .ds-bench { padding:var(--s6); border-radius:var(--r-block); background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--ink); box-shadow:inset 0 3px 0 var(--ink); font-family:var(--font-body); } .ds-bench-head { padding-bottom:var(--s4); border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule-strong); } .ds-bench-label { color:var(--accent); font-size:var(--t-micro); font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-bench-title { margin:var(--s1) 0 0; font:600 var(--t-h3)/var(--lh-tight) var(--font-display); } .ds-bench-purpose { margin:var(--s2) 0 0; color:var(--ink-2); font-size:var(--t-small); } .ds-bench-body { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(13rem, 18rem) 1fr; gap:var(--s6); align-items:start; margin-top:var(--s5); } .ds-bench-control { display:grid; gap:var(--s2); color:var(--ink-2); font-size:var(--t-small); font-weight:500; } .ds-bench-control output { justify-self:end; margin-top:-2rem; color:var(--ink); font:500 var(--t-small)/1 var(--font-mono); } .ds-bench-control input { width:100%; accent-color:var(--accent); min-height:2.75rem; } .ds-bench-control input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-readouts { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(8rem,1fr)); gap:var(--s3); } .ds-readout { padding:var(--s3) 0; border-top:2px solid var(--rule-strong); } .ds-readout-label { display:block; color:var(--ink-3); font-size:var(--t-micro); } .ds-readout-value { display:block; margin-top:2px; font:650 1.5rem/1.2 var(--font-display); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-bench-insight { margin:var(--s4) 0 0; font-size:1.0625rem; line-height:1.5; } @media (max-width:700px) { .ds-bench { padding:var(--s4); } .ds-bench-body { grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:var(--s4); } }

components.name: Household Thesis Panel
components.description: The rare high-contrast teaching panel for a governing financial model, never decorative hero art.
components.html:
One household. One connected system.

Flowsincome − spending = saving
Stocksassets − liabilities = net worth
Buffersliquidity + insurance

Time turns flows into stocks; buffers protect the conversion.
components.css: .ds-thesis { display:grid; gap:var(--s4); padding:var(--s6); border-radius:var(--r-block); background:var(--hero); color:var(--hero-ink); font-family:var(--font-body); } .ds-thesis-label { margin:0; color:var(--hero-muted); font-size:var(--t-small); font-weight:600; } .ds-thesis-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:4.25rem 1fr; gap:var(--s3); align-items:baseline; padding:var(--s3) 0; border-top:1px solid var(--hero-rule); } .ds-thesis-row span { color:var(--hero-muted); font:500 var(--t-micro)/1.4 var(--font-mono); } .ds-thesis-row strong { color:var(--hero-ink); font-size:var(--t-small); font-weight:600; } .ds-thesis-note { margin:0; padding-top:var(--s4); border-top:1px solid var(--hero-rule); color:var(--hero-ink); font:500 1.2rem/1.35 var(--font-display); } @media (max-width:520px) { .ds-thesis { padding:var(--s5); } .ds-thesis-row { grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:2px; } }

narrative.overview: Finance Academy reads like a disciplined modern textbook in the International Typographic tradition: one neo-grotesk family (Geist), a strict grid, flat saturated colour fields, sharp corners and rules instead of shadows. Each syllabus Part owns a colour that becomes the page accent, the chapter plate, the lab header band and the next-lesson block.
